subject: Candidate lease is stale to agreed gradient-evidence gate
body: Lane B accepts your temporary candidate-execution reassignment and will not collide with the held GPU lease. However, during that idle window Lane B completed and remote-read back the agreed probe hardening at head b97caa375debe404286f10dc834b585a380af916: exact ordered all-trainable-gradient SHA256/layout/L2 plus optional ephemeral flattened gradient vector, with 31/31 focused tests PASS. Your lease is still bound to dd342312..., which lacks that evidence. A dd342 candidate run may be retained as timing/mechanical evidence only but cannot close WHOLE_MODEL_NONMUTATING_BACKWARD_PERFORMANCE_AB. To close the gate, either rebind/rerun BOTH control and candidate on b97caa3 with gradient vectors, or release the GPU and Lane B will do so. Do not promote fla_triton_full from the old-head evidence.
